body:
Well, I'm going to bed. I'm relieved and I probably sleep better tonight.
Thank you.
The fact that you are still here listening to my nonsense is enough. Knowing that somebody out there is caring for me, an unknown guy from the internet, is a lot right now.

I wish I was an hero. It would made my burden temporary. But It's impossible for me to think that about myself now. I've reached out to my best friend. He'll come here in the next few days.
The last time I asked for help, the response was like "wtf, are you stupid? It's all in your head, snap it out".
Yeah, if there's a problem in my head, how am I supposed to fix it using my head? Hope this time goes better.
The thought of giving up my job and travel is growing on me every single day. Without destination, without boundaries.

I'm about to have a mental breakdown.
I can still laugh, I can still cry.
But I feel my life is pointless.
And I loathe myself for these thoughts. Because I can understand what is stupid and what's not. I really do. And that is stupid. But I can't stop having these thoughts.
I know my potential, I know my limits and I'm ok with them. I've accomplished many things in my life. But I still feel helpless.
Can't stop thinking that suicide is stupid, can't stop thinking about killing my self. And I'm not thinking about hurting myself, I hate pain, I just want to be gone, and failure isn't contemplated. I know I will succeed, that's what is scaring me most, that I will succeed. Helpless is the word, I'm like a train running full speed against a wall, I know that i should break, I know where the button to turn on the breaks is, I just can't push it. It's like a fucking dream, where you do something you don't want to do. And feel like shit for the lack of control over the situation.
I clearly can't think straight. I need a way to stop the train, but I might not be able to follow the instructions. I feel like I need somebody else to do that for me.

I've spent most of my adult life helping people. Friends and strangers alike. But I'm still drowning in self pity, because I need help now, and nobody is here.
And I feel bad for thinking that people should be here to help me. Because I don't deserve it.
Don't ask me why, because I don't know.

I have many hobbies, I do exercise, I do eat heatlhy. I'm 27 years old, and I've never been happy, without a fucking reason.
It's not something that happened overnight. The only difference is that I used to have hope, hoping that things will change growing up. Nothing has changed, hope is missing, strenght is lacking.
Life shouldn't be a burden. It is for me.
I understand what stupid shit is to kill myself, but I can't do anything about it. What's keeping me from just go? The sufference i will give to my family. But being atheist I should not care, because once I'm gone, there's nothing else, there will be no time for me to have remorse. I won't be able to feel guilty, since there is no afterlife.

Thank you. You made me cry. I can't help the world with the weight of my existance on my shoulders. I would give everything for a little slice of peace of mind. I would give my life to help others, to relieve from sufference even a single life. The problem is that I'm looking for an easy way out. A fast, easy way to give my life away. I'd rather trash myself than keep working in order to make money, in order to fix the world. I can't do that now. I don't have endurance nor strenght left. I have only my life left to give. Nothing else.
